claims.statement: For every finite Boolean f under an interior product measure and physical block A, L_A=M_A+J_A, J_A=I(Z;T)>=0, and J_A<=M_A+Delta_A(p).
The universal claim J_A<=M_A at arbitrary product biases is false.
M,J,Delta add for exact disjoint products/tensors with aligned blocks; no general nonlinear Boolean composition transfer is proved.
claims.countercontrol: AND of two uniform dictators has base ledger totals zero but composite M=J=1 when one input is revealed.

claims.statement: For fixed 0<q<1/2, biased two-bit AND with p tending to zero has J-M=4q(1-2q)p log2(1/p)+O(p).
claims.consequence: No uniform correction O(p) can replace the rare logarithm on this family.
claims.limitation: Does not prove exact Delta coefficient sharp or a hierarchy payment.

claims.statement: No dimension-independent universal entropy-influence constant is proved or refuted by this run.
